summary: Bite's kiosk ordering software is used by chains including Portillo's and Big Chicken, across 1,100+ restaurant locations.
Bite raised $9 million in Series A funding (announced April 2024) to accelerate self-service kiosk ordering; the company was founded in 2015 and is based in New York City.

Bite's patented 'Bite Lift' AI analyzes kiosk transactions to make real-time upsell recommendations, which the company says drive 20% higher check averages. (Scope note: 20% check-average lift is a vendor claim, not independently audited.)
